articles.title: 鄂海红：当AI成为科学家，构建AI4S可信基础设施 | WYSS 2026
articles.titleEn: Haihong E at WYSS 2026: Building Trustworthy Infrastructure for AI for Science
articles.summary: 鄂海红教授在世界青年科学家峰会欧洲专场与温州平行论坛作报告，围绕科学证据核验、科研诚信与学术出版，分享 AI4S 可信基础设施研究。
articles.summaryEn: At the WYSS 2026 European event and Wenzhou parallel forum, Haihong E discusses scientific evidence verification, research integrity and trustworthy infrastructure for AI for Science.
